source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of experimental design (PDF 203-204).

blocks.text: Jab sciencedan koi khayal jaanchte hain to tajarbe ki ehtiyat se mansooba bandi karte hain; yeh experimental design hai. Woh subjects chunte aur halaat qaboo karte hain taa ke nataij munsifana hon, phir aik cheez, independent variable, badal kar dekhte hain ke yeh doosri, dependent variable, par kya asar dalti hai, taa ke pata chale hypothesis sahih hai ya ghalat.

blocks.caption: Variables aur groups
rows: woh awamil jo tajarba karne wala asar dekhne ke liye badalta hai
jo naapa jata hai; independent variable ke jawab mein badalta hai
baqi sab awamil, munsifana test ke liye aik jaise rakhe jate
ilaaj nahi milta; muqable ke liye bunyad
jaancha ja raha ilaaj milta hai; control group se muqabla

blocks.prompt: Lobia ki barhotri par khaad ke test mein independent aur dependent variables batayein.
blocks.explanation: Independent: khaad ki miqdar ya maujoodgi. Dependent: lobia ki barhotri (maslan unchai).

items: Independent variable badlein, dependent naapein, control variables aik jaise rakhein.
Experimental group ka control group se muqabla karein.
